NOMAD.gloss: a member of a people who have no permanent home but move about according to the seasons
NOMAD.definition: A member of a people who have no permanent home but move about according to the seasons.

MONAD.gloss: an atom having a valence of one
MONAD.definition: (chemistry) an atom having a valence of one.

MOAN.gloss: an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
MOAN.definition: An utterance expressing pain or disapproval.

MAN.gloss: an adult person who is male
MAN.definition: An adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman).

MAD.example: Stayed huffy a good while"- Mark Twain.

DON.gloss: teacher at a university or college
DON.definition: Teacher at a university or college (especially at Cambridge or Oxford).

DAM.definition: A barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea.

MOD.gloss: a British teenager or young adult in the 1960s
MOD.definition: A British teenager or young adult in the 1960s; noted for their clothes consciousness and opposition to the rockers.
